description: Defines classes, structures, and functions related to UE (User Equipment) management in a 5G network, including context, handover, and candidate cell handling within the CU-CP (Central Unit - Control Plane) component.

classes.name: cu_cp_ue
classes.description: Represents a User Equipment (UE) in the CU-CP context, managing its state, context, and communication interfaces.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels all pending UE tasks.

methods.name: get_ue_index
methods.description: Returns the UE index.

methods.name: get_pci
methods.description: Returns the PCI of the UE.

methods.name: get_c_rnti
methods.description: Returns the C-RNTI of the UE.

methods.name: get_du_id
methods.description: Returns the DU ID associated with the UE.

methods.name: get_du_index
methods.description: Returns the DU index of the UE.

methods.name: get_cu_up_index
methods.description: Returns the CU-UP index of the UE.

methods.name: get_pcell_index
methods.description: Returns the primary cell index of the UE.

methods.name: get_up_resource_manager
methods.description: Returns the UP resource manager instance.

methods.name: get_task_sched
methods.description: Returns the task scheduler instance.

methods.name: get_security_manager
methods.description: Returns the security manager instance.

methods.name: get_ue_context
methods.description: Returns the UE context structure.

methods.name: get_location_manager
methods.description: Returns the location manager instance.

methods.name: get_meas_context
methods.description: Returns the measurement context.

methods.name: get_ran_paging_timer
methods.description: Returns the RAN paging timer.

methods.name: get_rna_update_timer
methods.description: Returns the RNA update timer.

methods.name: update_du_ue
methods.description: Updates the DU context with PCI and/or C-RNTI.

methods.name: update_meas_context
methods.description: Updates the measurement context.

methods.name: du_ue_created
methods.description: Checks if the DU UE context has been created.

methods.name: set_rrc_ue
methods.description: Associates an RRC UE interface with this UE.

methods.name: set_cu_up_index
methods.description: Sets the CU-UP index.

methods.name: get_ngap_rrc_ue_notifier

methods.name: get_ngap_cu_cp_ue_notifier
methods.description: Returns the NGAP CU-CP UE notifier.

methods.name: get_nrppa_cu_cp_ue_notifier
methods.description: Returns the NRPPA CU-CP UE notifier.

methods.name: get_rrc_ue_cu_cp_ue_notifier

methods.name: get_rrc_ue_cu_cp_adapter
methods.description: Returns the RRC UE to CU-CP adapter.

methods.name: get_rrc_ue
methods.description: Returns the RRC UE interface pointer.

methods.name: get_measurement_results

methods.name: get_handover_ue_release_timer
